Smoother canvas: the picture now goes straight from your graphics card to the screen.

- Zooming, panning and painting on large images are smoother: the sharp view is drawn by the graphics card directly onto the screen (Metal on Mac, Direct3D on Windows) instead of being copied through memory. On computers where that isn't possible, Greylight automatically uses the previous method.
- Help > System check shows how the canvas reaches your screen.
- Settings, recent files and your sign-in are saved more reliably on Windows.
- Signing out no longer risks being undone by a save still in progress.

Requires: macOS 12 Monterey or newer (Apple silicon and Intel); Windows 10 version 1809 or newer, 64-bit.
